It features a central space that is relatively flat and open compared to the rest of the [[Echovald Forest]]. It is currently heavily populated by the [[Dredge]], with [[Warden]]s mostly confined to the southern areas. The northwestern slopes are populated by [[Mantid]]s due to the streams in that area. ==Getting there== All of the [[primary quest]]s acquired in [[House zu Heltzer]] lead through here, including [[the Defenders of the Forest]], [[Defend Fort Aspenwood]], and [[The Jade Quarry (Kurzick quest)|the Jade Quarry]].
